create.name: Melinda Quesenberry
create.bio:
Melinda Quesenberry is a mindfulness coach and meditation teacher who lives in Honolulu, Hawaiʻi. She trained in psychology to master's level, is certified to teach yoga at the 500-hour level, and has spent more than ten years teaching yoga, meditation and mindfulness. Her interest runs through positive psychology and human behaviour, and her teaching centres on self-compassion and on meeting life as it actually is rather than as we wish it were.

She is best known online as the creator of Inner Shift, formerly Theta Thoughts, a library of spoken affirmation meditations set over binaural beats, many designed to be played while falling asleep, with themes such as acceptance, self-trust, love and the moon's cycles. Inner Shift has a large following on Insight Timer and YouTube. Today most of her time goes into private fifty-minute mindfulness sessions, offered on a sliding scale and begun with a short free conversation. She wrote the poems in her book May You Know Peace during a time of heartbreak, and she also writes This Little Life, a Substack of reflections on being human, alongside occasional free group sits on Zoom.

books.title: May You Know Peace: An Invitation to Embrace Your Life, As It Is
books.author: Melinda Quesenberry
books.description: A short book of poems that grew out of a painful break-up and her own mindfulness practice. The pieces turn on change, kindness towards oneself, letting go and noticing small moments of beauty.

courses.title: Individual Mindfulness Sessions
courses.description: Private fifty-minute mindfulness sessions focused on self-compassion, awareness of habitual patterns and steadiness through change. A free fifteen-minute call comes first to see whether the fit is right.

free_resources.title: Melinda Quesenberry on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Inner Shift tracks on Insight Timer: spoken affirmations layered over binaural beats, with sets for the new and full moon, mornings, letting go and a Hawaiian ho'oponopono practice. Free to listen to in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: This Little Life
free_resources.description: Her free Substack of personal essays on mindfulness and the untidy business of being human, which also announces her occasional free online meditation gatherings.

flags: Listed under her own name, not 'Inner Shift' (the progress queue name is her project's name); the Insight Timer profile and YouTube channel are both branded Inner Shift, and the YouTube count was added to her total because the channel is hers alone.
Availability set to local_online (Honolulu) from her own site ('Honolulu, Hawaiʻi + Online'), but her Psychology Today listing says 'Available online only'; a human may prefer worldwide.
Videos are affirmation tracks spoken over binaural beats rather than talks; I couldn't confirm the voice is hers, though she presents Inner Shift as her creation.

Psychology Today lists her under 'therapists' with a $120 'one-on-one therapy' line; her own site calls the work mindfulness coaching, and its listed specialties (self-compassion, stress, burnout, life transitions) aren't medical conditions, so she was kept.
Last Insight Timer upload about four years ago and YouTube uploads 3–4 years old; her coaching and Substack are current (posts to Oct 2026).
Second photo is the same portrait as the first (Psychology Today copy, 320×400); only one distinct photo confirmed.
